It is imperative that we remain vigilant, sharing intelligence and resources, to ensure lasting peace and stability for the people of Iraq and the broader region.

The best way, in the long run, to reduce the pressures that create illegal immigration is to address the underlying factors driving individuals to seek refuge beyond their borders. By investing in education, economic opportunities, and community development in their home countries, we can foster environments where families feel safe and empowered. Collaborative international efforts will be paramount, as we work together to create pathways for stability, ensuring everyone has the chance to thrive where they belong.
